# MLB.com

> > Official home of Major League Baseball with live scores, schedules, standings, team rosters, and Spring Training coverage for all 30 MLB teams.

MLB.com serves as the central digital hub for Major League Baseball, providing comprehensive coverage of regular season games, postseason playoffs, World Series, World Baseball Classic, and Spring Training. The site offers team-specific pages, real-time statistics, video highlights, and ticket purchasing for franchises including the Detroit Tigers, Boston Red Sox, Minnesota Twins, Los Angeles Dodgers, and all other MLB organizations.

## Key Topics

- MLB (Major League Baseball)
- World Baseball Classic
- Spring Training
- Postseason & World Series
- Detroit Tigers
- Boston Red Sox
- Minnesota Twins
- Los Angeles Dodgers
- Arizona Diamondbacks
- Cleveland Guardians
- Team schedules & standings
- Roster news
- Ticket sales
- Baseball statistics
- Video highlights & bat tracking technology

## Core MLB Resources

- [MLB.com | The Official Site of Major League Baseball](https://mlb.com): MLB homepage with World Baseball Classic, scores, and Spring Training
- [MLB Schedule 2026: Baseball Games Today | MLB.com](https://mlb.com/schedule): 2026 MLB game schedule: WBC Pool Play and Spring Training games
- [MLB Postseason 2025: Playoff Bracket and World Series Schedule | MLB.com](https://mlb.com/postseason): 2025 MLB playoff bracket, schedules, and World Series information
- [2026 MLB Standings and Records: Spring Training | MLB.com](https://mlb.com/standings): 2026 MLB Spring Training standings and team records
- [All 30 MLB Teams: Location, Stadium and Website Information | MLB.com](https://mlb.com/team): Directory of all 30 MLB teams with stadium locations and contacts
